description:
🏎️Turn your backyard into a racetrack with the FLYPKIN Drift Go Kart — a fast, safe, and durable electric ride-on your kid will love. This high-performance go kart packs dual 390W motors for strong acceleration, a kid-safe max speed of 4 MPH, and smooth rear drift tires that make every ride feel like an adventure.

Built with a sturdy steel frame and certified to UL2272 safety standards, it’s designed for long-lasting fun and parent peace of mind. One charge delivers up to 8 miles of play, giving kids plenty of time to cruise, drift, and explore.

Perfect for children ages 6+ and supporting up to 120 lbs, this go kart is an easy way to introduce young riders to electric vehicles while keeping outdoor play exciting. If you want a gift that brings real thrills and real smiles, this is it.

Dual 390W Motors for Strong Performance

Equipped with two powerful 390W motors, this go kart delivers smooth acceleration and exciting riding power that kids can feel from the moment they hit the pedal.

Kid-Safe 4 MPH Max Speed

Designed with young riders in mind, the 4 MPH top speed provides the perfect balance of fun and safety—fast enough to thrill, slow enough for parents to trust.

Smooth Drifting Rear Tires

Special rear tires make drifting easy and controlled, giving kids a fun, racetrack-style riding experience right in the backyard.

Long Playtime & High Weight Capacity

Enjoy up to 8 miles per charge with a weight capacity of up to 120 lbs, making it a great choice for kids ages 6 and up who want hours of outdoor adventure.

Durable Steel Frame + CPC Certified

Built with a strong steel frame and CPC electrical safety certification, this ride-on ensures reliable performance and long-lasting durability for everyday play.
